_note: Convention confirmed against OutputBox/CHECK/{YYYY}/{YYYY_MM}/, which matches the form already used in Intake_Checks. Note 'Check' is title case and the date is NOT zero-padded (1_5_2026). The output folder also contains bad duplicates from an earlier attempt -- 'CHECK_38509_ Dalya Pop_11_07_2026.pdf' (uppercase type, leading space, mixed-case payee, wrong month) beside the correct 'Check_38509_DAL YA POP_1_7_2026.pdf' -- and the validate regex rejects those. checkNumber and payee extract cleanly from the OCR text; checkDate is the weak field, since OCR renders slashes as digits (1/5/2026 -> 11512026).
